value.hint: Weigh the heat by what each row cost or earned instead of counting rows: where the most was fired, spent, lost or earned.
value.netHint: Net is earned minus paid: the positive ramp where more was earned, the negative ramp where more was paid.
value.estimated: {pct}% of the priced rows use a class average or an estimate (the Cost source column filters them).
value.sources: Real-world prices are public unit costs in US dollars of the year given; game economies are the games' own; a converter's own cost and income columns come first.
value.none: No value columns in this data: nothing it names is in the price tables, and the source wrote none of its own.
insights.say.value.lost: Costly ground: {value} {unit} paid here, {share}% of all, {ratio}× the rate of paying elsewhere
insights.say.value.earned: Earning ground: {value} {unit} earned here, {share}% of all, {ratio}× the rate of earning elsewhere
